Class Registrations

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.Registrations
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class Registrations extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Everything one plugin adds to Core, taken back with one call in shutdown(). Each method registers at once and remembers how to undo it; close() undoes them all, newest first. Nothing is left behind after a reload, and no unregister line can be forgotten. 
private final Registrations core = new Registrations("Dragons");

protected void setup() {
    core.settingsTab(new SettingsTab("Dragons", settings(config), config::save));
    core.helpTopic(new HelpTopic("dragons", 50, Message.raw("Dragons"), "Rock_Gem_Ruby", uuid -> lines(uuid)));
    core.helpCommand("server.dragons.help.mod", "/dragons", Message.translation("server.dragons.help.open"));
    core.hudLine("dragons.next", uuid -> nextDragonLine(uuid));
    core.placeholder("dragons_slain", uuid -> String.valueOf(slain(uuid)));
    core.onWallet(walletListener);
    core.edition(isPro, List.of("any number of dragons"), licensedTo);
    core.every(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS, () -> spawnDragons());   // a timer thread, stopped by close()
    core.onClose(() -> config.save());                          // anything else to do in shutdown()
}

public void shutdown() {
    core.close();
    super.shutdown();
}
Safe to use from setup() and shutdown() on any thread. A registry call that fails in close() is logged and the rest are still undone.
